newsitem.title: USA: Atlas run by management committee.
newsitem.headline: Atlas run by management committee.

text.p: Atlas Corp said Monday a committee consisting of Richard Blubaugh, vice president environmental/governmental affairs, James Jensen, treasurer and Gregg Shafter, vIce president project development, has been appointed by the board of directors to manage the affairs of the company until a new chief executive officer has been named.

Atlas said Mario Caron, its interim CEO, is leaving to become president and CEO of Eden Roc Mineral Corp in Toronto. Mr. Caron joined Atlas as a director in September and was appointed as interim CEO in December. He aided Atlas's return to active production, said the company, and played a key role in its recent acquisition of Arisur, Inc and its Bolivian properties. He will continue as a director of
Atlas also said perlite mine and processing facilities built by its subsidiary, Cornerstone Industrial Minerals Corp, have been completed. Cornerstone expects delivery will begin later this month.
Atlas Corporation is an international diversified mining company with gold development and exploration projects in North America and lead, zinc and silver production in Bolivia.
